row.Selected-grade rationale: Documented commercial formulation; traceable manufacturer evidence Filed under TPC / TPEE on 2026-09-28 (m223-what-the-makers-say-it-is), moved from TPE, polymer not stated: copolyester elastomer blend, "Thermoplastic polyester (CAS-No.) Trade Secret 48.5 – 50" (D-NINJATEK-CHINCHILLA-SDS-US, p. 1). Its safety data sheet gives a thermoplastic polyester elastomer and another thermoplastic elastomer at 48.5 to 50 % each ("a combination of premium TPE resins", its sheet says), naming the second only as a TPE. The one elastomer named is a copolyester, so it is filed under TPC / TPEE as a declared softer grade (75 Shore A): its values stay its own and do not pull the estimate. Read by an AI agent (claude-opus-5.5), not a person.
